Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: you are having lip swelling for the past 1 hr.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Lip swelling began after the patient ate prawn soup.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: It started after eating a prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The patient initially experienced a weird sensation around the lips.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: You initially had some weird feeling around your lips

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Swelling started about 30 minutes after eating and is localized to the upper lip.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: The swelling started after half an hour. Swelling is on the upper lip.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports a sensation of throat closing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Now you are complaining of your throat closing

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has chest tightness with difficulty breathing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Your chest is tight at the moment with difficulty breathing

History_of_Present_Illness.content: A similar episode occurred approximately one year ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: You mention that a similar episode occurred approximately one year ago

Physical_Findings.content: During consultation, the patient appeared to have breathing difficulties.
Physical_Findings.source_text: during the consultation, it looked like you were having some problems breathing

Physical_Findings.content: Examination showed progressively increasing lip swelling.
Physical_Findings.source_text: your lips appeared to be increasingly swelling

Medications.content: Patient is currently using salbutamol inhalers.
Medications.source_text: you are currently on salbutamol inhalers

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: You have had an injection as a child for a peanut allergy

Assessment.source_text: we are suspecting an anaphylactic reaction

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised immediate administration of an antihistamine.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I have advised that you use an antihistamine straight away

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised mother to call an ambulance via 999.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I have advised Mom to call the ambulance as a 999 call

Follow_up_Information.content: After hospital discharge, patient to book a review with a doctor to consider prescribing an epipen.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: After discharge from hospital please book a review with the doctor to consider prescribing an epipen
